ELEMENT_FLASK_RELIC.title: Element Flask
ELEMENT_FLASK_RELIC.description:
At the start of each combat, add an Element Flask to your hand.
Upon entering a Rest Site, restore its uses to 3.
ELEMENT_FLASK_RELIC.flavor: A golden chalice modeled after one graced by a tear of blessing.

RED_TEARSTONE_RING_RELIC.title: Red Tearstone Ring
RED_TEARSTONE_RING_RELIC.description: While your HP is at or below {HpThreshold:diff()}% of your Max HP, gain {Strength:diff()} Strength and {Magic:diff()} Magic.
RED_TEARSTONE_RING_RELIC.flavor: A rare tearstone jewel set in a ring. Said to be a tear of mourning from the goddess Caitha—and tears are always more beautiful near death.

MAGIC_SCORPION_CHARM_RELIC.title: Magic Scorpion Charm
MAGIC_SCORPION_CHARM_RELIC.description:
At the start of each combat, gain {Magic:diff()} Magic.
Take {DamageTaken:diff()}% more damage from enemies.
MAGIC_SCORPION_CHARM_RELIC.flavor: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart that shimmers with magic.
